checks.name: Both reviewed immutable commit trees match
Complete committed, frozen, extracted and ZIP source equality
Freeze and pre-execution authentication receipts cross-bind exact source
Every saved fresh process, golden, artifact, dependency copy and corruption authenticated
Entire initial evidence manifest and committed bytes authenticated
Exact committed CI bootstrap pins, tested runtime and all old workflows preserved
All future readback targets equal reviewed Git bytes without HTTP
Public source and delivery exclusion independently checked
checks.limitation: Exact bytes and path checks do not detect paraphrases; the public-safe methods note was separately read for scope.

checks.name: Published numeric summaries and scientific limitations agree with saved exact certificate
checks.scope: Conditional actual linear first variation at ell=10^-6; zero existence only; no finite-amplitude nonlinear waveform, effective epsilon, observed scale, cosmological-origin inference or external peer-review claim.

review_method: Independent stdlib hashes, immutable Git blob reads, ZIP member reads, exact saved JSON/CSV and diagnostics comparisons. No scientific checker reruns, HTTP or Git mutations. Only this audit helper and receipt are written outside frozen source.
readiness: Accepted as complete local replay and committed initial evidence. Remote CI, merge, deployment and live readback must pass their separate gates; this audit does not assert remote completion.
limitations: Finite arithmetic and internal independent review do not establish the analytic PDE/exact-family premises or external peer review. Private exclusion is an exact-byte/path audit; the public-safe methods note was separately read for scope.
